To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the adoption of advanced technology and market competition are the key drivers in the adoption of sophisticated design of MAS in manufacturing firms in Malaysia.
the adoption of MAS design by the Malaysian manufacturing firms is significantly influenced by AMT adoption and by market competition.
The sophistication of MAS design is significantly and positively influenced by AMT adoption and the level of market competition.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the relationship between decentralisation, advanced manufacturing technology adoption, market competition and MAS design.
the MAS design of manufacturing firms in Malaysia, and the factors that influence MAS design.
how the MAS designers can help the managers of the organization to cope with the dynamic and changing business environment.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the MAS design in manufacturing firms is significantly influenced by the adoption of AMT and market competition.
MAS design should be tailored according to the needs of the firm.
MAS sophistication is influenced by the level of AMT adoption and the level of market competition.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the MAS designers need to consider the adoption of sophisticated AMT and market competition in the MAS design process in order to improve the effectiveness and the relevance of the MAS design.
MAS design is influenced by the AMT adoption and competition in the market.
MAS designers should be aware of the changes in the manufacturing environment and the business environment in which they are operating and the need to provide timely information for decision making.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the MAS designers should be aware that the MAS design is not only about the design of the MAS itself but it is also about the adoption of AMT and the market competition.
MAS sophistication is positively related to the use of AMT and market competition.
the MAS design should not be viewed in isolation from other organizational and business changes that are taking place within the manufacturing firm.
